lines.zh: 我走过草地，草叶竖起又伏下。
lines.en: I cross the grass and blades rise, then fall.

lines.zh: 鞋底在地面擦出细小的火花。
lines.en: My soles strike small sparks off the ground.

lines.zh: 我的步子很轻，身上却嗡嗡响。
lines.en: My steps are light, yet I hum all over.

lines.zh: 每走一步，指尖就亮一下。
lines.en: Each step makes my fingertips flash.

lines.zh: 我沿着铁轨走，铁比土更好导电。
lines.en: I walk the rails; iron conducts better than dirt.

lines.zh: 我抬手扶了扶漏电的护腕。
lines.en: I lift a hand and set my leaking bracer straight.

lines.zh: 走近水边时，我绕了一个弯。
lines.en: Near water I take a wide detour.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，电荷一直在积。
lines.en: I move slowly and the charge keeps building.

lines.zh: 风把我的头发吹得直立起来。
lines.en: The wind leaves my hair standing straight up.

lines.zh: 我踩过的石头带一点麻。
lines.en: The stones I step on carry a faint tingle.

lines.zh: 我一停下，脚边的草就抖。
lines.en: The moment I stop, the grass at my feet shivers.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，像拖一根电线。
lines.en: I drag my steps like dragging a live wire.

lines.zh: 我站着，指尖噼啪响了三次。
lines.en: I stand still and my fingers crackle three times.

lines.zh: 电荷条在我胸口慢慢亮起来。
lines.en: The charge bar brightens slowly across my chest.

lines.zh: 我把手指张开，让电跑掉一点。
lines.en: I spread my fingers and let some charge escape.

lines.zh: 空气里有金属味，是我的味道。
lines.en: There is metal in the air; that smell is mine.

lines.zh: 没有目标时，我身上的光会暗。
lines.en: With no target, my glow dims.

lines.zh: 我一下一下掐着手指，数到十。
lines.en: I tap my fingers and count to ten.

lines.zh: 罐子早没了，我只剩这身电线。
lines.en: The canister is long gone; only the wiring remains.

lines.zh: 我盯着手掌，血管在发光。
lines.en: I stare at my palm; the veins are glowing.

lines.zh: 远处有雷，我抬头听了很久。
lines.en: Thunder sounds far off and I listen a long while.

lines.zh: 我把护腕拆下，又装回去。
lines.en: I take the bracer off and put it back on.

lines.zh: 电在我牙缝里跳，我咬着不放。
lines.en: Lightning jumps between my teeth and I bite down.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气带着一点点蓝。
lines.en: My breath comes out faintly blue.

lines.zh: 我数着心跳，像在数电压。
lines.en: I count heartbeats as if counting voltage.

lines.zh: 安静时我也在充电，只是慢。
lines.en: Even at rest I charge, only slowly.

lines.zh: 我把手指插进土里，电跑了一路。
lines.en: I push my fingers into soil and current runs through.

lines.zh: 肩上的线圈松了一圈，我拧紧。
lines.en: A coil on my shoulder loosens; I tighten it.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，也在数还能放几次。
lines.en: Standing still, I count how many discharges remain.

lines.zh: 雨落到我身上，噼啪更响了。
lines.en: Rain falls on me, and the crackle grows louder.

lines.zh: 我一抬眼看你，指尖就亮了。
lines.en: I raise my eyes to you and my fingertips light.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁片让我很感兴趣。
lines.en: The iron on you interests me greatly.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，空气开始发麻。
lines.en: While I look at you, the air begins to sting.

lines.zh: 你的剑是铁的吗，我在判断。
lines.en: Is your sword iron? I am deciding.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的胸甲，那里最近。
lines.en: I fix on your chestplate; it is nearest.

lines.zh: 你后退，我的目光跟着你的脚。
lines.en: You retreat and my gaze follows your feet.

lines.zh: 我看你不像看人，像看导体。
lines.en: I regard you not as a person but as a conductor.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡光，我看见了缝隙。
lines.en: You raise a hand against the glare and I see a gap.

lines.zh: 我眯眼，睫毛上跳着火星。
lines.en: I narrow my eyes, sparks jumping on my lashes.

lines.zh: 你看过来，我指间就多一道弧。
lines.en: You look over and an arc forms between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我在你身上找最湿的那处。
lines.en: I look for the wettest part of you.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我脚边，我没动。
lines.en: Your shadow falls at my feet and I do not move.

lines.zh: 你的剑落下，电顺着它爬。
lines.en: Your sword falls and the charge climbs it.

lines.zh: 伤口边缘焦黑，没有流血。
lines.en: The wound is charred at the edges; no blood.

lines.zh: 我被砍得歪了一下，电荷掉一格。
lines.en: The cut knocks me crooked and the charge drops a notch.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的手抖得更厉害。
lines.en: That blow makes my hands shake harder.

lines.zh: 护甲挡住大半，剩下的进了肉。
lines.en: Armor stops most of it; the rest gets through.

lines.zh: 疼的时候，我指尖漏出一串火花。
lines.en: When it hurts, sparks leak from my fingertips.

lines.zh: 我退后，把电荷都收进掌心。
lines.en: I back off and gather all the charge into my palms.

lines.zh: 你的刀柄要是铁的，你也会麻。
lines.en: If your hilt is iron, you will feel it too.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，牙齿间有蓝光。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and blue light shows between them.

lines.zh: 别碰我伤口，那里还是带电的。
lines.en: Do not touch the wound; it is still charged.

lines.zh: 你举着铁锭，我一步步靠近。
lines.en: You hold up an iron ingot and I come closer, step by step.

lines.zh: 铜线比面包香得多。
lines.en: Copper wire smells far better than bread.

lines.zh: 你把红石放在地上，我蹲下去看。
lines.en: You set redstone on the ground and I crouch over it.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只想摸一摸你的甲。
lines.en: I do not eat; I only want to touch your armor.

lines.zh: 你晃火把没用，晃铁镐有用。
lines.en: A torch does nothing; an iron pickaxe works.

lines.zh: 雷声一响，我就忘了你在引诱我。
lines.en: Thunder sounds and I forget you were luring me.

lines.zh: 水桶离我远点，我不想短路。
lines.en: Keep the bucket away; I do not want to short out.

lines.zh: 你把门打开，我跟着铁铰链走。
lines.en: You open the door and I follow the iron hinges.

lines.zh: 我朝你的剑伸手，不是要打你。
lines.en: I reach for your sword, not to strike you.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我指尖的火跟着你。
lines.en: When you pull back, the spark at my fingertip follows.

lines.zh: 你一碰我，手指就麻了一下。
lines.en: One touch and your finger goes numb.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，空气里有细小的爆响。
lines.en: We collide and the air pops faintly.

lines.zh: 我被撞得滑开，鞋底留一道焦痕。
lines.en: The hit slides me back, leaving a scorch mark.

lines.zh: 你隔着衣服碰我，也会被电一下。
lines.en: Even through cloth, touching me stings.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我多充了一点电。
lines.en: The impact charges me a little more.

lines.zh: 你撞到护腕，火花溅到草上。
lines.en: You hit my bracer and sparks fall into the grass.

lines.zh: 我不重，可撞上来像一堵墙。
lines.en: I am not heavy, yet I hit like a wall.

lines.zh: 你退开时甩手，我知道你被电了。
lines.en: You pull back shaking your hand; I know it stung.

lines.zh: 我站稳，身上的嗡声高了半调。
lines.en: I steady myself and my hum rises half a tone.

lines.zh: 碰我最好用木棍，别用手。
lines.en: Use a wooden stick on me, never your hand.

lines.zh: 另一个导电者在雨里，我们对了对眼。
lines.en: Another conductor stands in the rain; we meet eyes.

lines.zh: 两股电荷靠近，空气开始发亮。
lines.en: Two charges near each other and the air lights up.

lines.zh: 我们指尖相触，谁也没被烧到。
lines.en: Our fingertips touch and neither of us burns.

lines.zh: 它比我多一格电，我慢慢补上。
lines.en: It holds one notch more than I do; I catch up slowly.

lines.zh: 并排时，我们的电弧接在一起。
lines.en: Side by side, our arcs join.

lines.zh: 我们不拥抱，怕一起跳闸。
lines.en: We do not embrace; we fear tripping together.

lines.zh: 它替我理好护腕，动作很轻。
lines.en: It straightens my bracer, very gently.

lines.zh: 我们轮流放电，像在对话。
lines.en: We discharge in turns, like talking.

lines.zh: 两个导电者靠近，雷更容易落。
lines.en: Two conductors close together draw the lightning.

lines.zh: 它熄灭时，我把剩下的电给了它。
lines.en: When it dims, I give it what charge I have left.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡铁粒，指尖把它吸起来。
lines.en: I bend for iron nuggets and my fingertips pull them up.

lines.zh: 红石掉在地上，我捏在手里发烫。
lines.en: Redstone falls and I pinch it, hot in my hand.

lines.zh: 铜锭我收进护腕的夹层。
lines.en: I tuck copper ingots into the bracer lining.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的箭一根根摆好。
lines.en: I line up the fallen arrows one by one.

lines.zh: 面包我不捡，捡了也没用。
lines.en: I leave the bread; picking it up would do nothing.

lines.zh: 地上的水我不敢碰，绕着走。
lines.en: I dare not touch the puddles and walk around them.

lines.zh: 我用脚把金属拨成一堆。
lines.en: I nudge the metal into a pile with my foot.

lines.zh: 你丢来的铁片贴在我手上不掉。
lines.en: The scrap you toss sticks to my hand.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根断线，接到自己腕上。
lines.en: I pick up a cut wire and splice it to my wrist.

lines.zh: 太重的东西我拖着走，一路火花。
lines.en: Heavy things I drag, trailing sparks all the way.

lines.zh: 你一站进十步，胸口的条开始涨。
lines.en: You come within ten paces and the bar on my chest climbs.

lines.zh: 我锁住你，电荷一格一格往上。
lines.en: I lock onto you and the charge steps up notch by notch.

lines.zh: 选你是因为你身上金属多。
lines.en: I choose you because you carry the most metal.

lines.zh: 你心跳快了，我的电也快了。
lines.en: Your heart speeds up and so does my current.

lines.zh: 我一指你，空气就变紧了。
lines.en: I point at you and the air tightens.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声嗡，是我在蓄。
lines.en: That hum you hear is me charging.

lines.zh: 我记住你的位置，电会自己找路。
lines.en: I mark your place; the current will find its way.

lines.zh: 你比旁边那个更容易导电。
lines.en: You conduct more easily than the one beside you.

lines.zh: 我选定目标时，头发全竖起来。
lines.en: When I choose a target, my hair stands up.

lines.zh: 现在开始，你每动一下我都在充。
lines.en: From now on, every movement of yours feeds me.

lines.zh: 我抬手，电弧先一步指向你。
lines.en: I lift my hand and the arc points at you first.

lines.zh: 你绕到我侧后，我转身很慢。
lines.en: You circle behind me and I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 电荷到八格了，我盯着你的脚。
lines.en: Charge is at eight; I stare at your feet.

lines.zh: 你躲到石后，电顺着湿土爬。
lines.en: You hide behind stone and the current crawls through wet soil.

lines.zh: 我抬手又放下，是在等你露头。
lines.en: I raise my hand and lower it, waiting for your head.

lines.zh: 你换位，我就重新算一次距离。
lines.en: You shift and I recalculate the distance.

lines.zh: 我离你越近，嗡声越尖。
lines.en: The closer I get, the sharper the hum.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我把电打在你脚边。
lines.en: You raise your shield and I strike the ground by your feet.

lines.zh: 你身上在滴水，这对我有利。
lines.en: You are dripping; that favors me.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼，电弧在指间打转。
lines.en: I close in step by step, arcs turning between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我一掌推来，六点力带着麻。
lines.en: I shove with an open palm, six points and a numb ache.

lines.zh: 手心的电窜进你的甲缝。
lines.en: The charge in my palm slips into your armor seams.

lines.zh: 我打得不狠，可你手指会僵。
lines.en: I do not hit hard, but your fingers will stiffen.

lines.zh: 放电弹离手时，亮得像一小片雷。
lines.en: The bolt leaves my hand bright as a scrap of thunder.

lines.zh: 十格电一次放完，我空了半秒。
lines.en: Ten charges gone at once, and I am empty half a second.

lines.zh: 电弧从我指尖跳到你的肩上。
lines.en: The arc leaps from my fingertip to your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你被电得退开，我补上第二下。
lines.en: You jerk back and I add a second blow.

lines.zh: 我打你的时候，自己也在发亮。
lines.en: As I strike you, I am glowing too.

lines.zh: 这一击之后，我得重新蓄。
lines.en: After this strike I must charge from scratch.

lines.zh: 你倒地时还在抽，我停手了。
lines.en: You twitch on the ground and I stop.

lines.zh: 我从菌染科学家的壳里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of an infected scientist's shell.

lines.zh: 第一次睁眼，指尖就冒了火花。
lines.en: My eyes open for the first time and sparks start.

lines.zh: 孢子在我血管里连成一条线。
lines.en: Spores link into a line through my veins.

lines.zh: 我出生时，附近的灯全闪了一下。
lines.en: At my birth, every nearby light flickered.

lines.zh: 我站起，护腕自己贴合手腕。
lines.en: I stand and the bracer fits itself to my wrist.

lines.zh: 旧身体还在地上，已经焦了。
lines.en: The old body lies on the ground, already charred.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，第一口气带着静电。
lines.en: I open my mouth; the first breath carries static.

lines.zh: 雷声在很远的地方，我却听见了。
lines.en: Thunder is far away, yet I hear it.

lines.zh: 我被拼起来时，关节里塞满铜线。
lines.en: When I was assembled, copper wire filled my joints.

lines.zh: 我一落地，草叶全竖了起来。
lines.en: The moment I land, every blade of grass stands up.

lines.zh: 出生那刻，罐子已经不见了。
lines.en: At my birth, the canister was already gone.

lines.zh: 我伸手，电弧打在自己的腿上。
lines.en: I reach out and an arc strikes my own leg.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的电就乱窜了。
lines.en: Fire touches me and my charge runs wild.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，落地炸出一片火花。
lines.en: I fall from height and burst into sparks on landing.

lines.zh: 水一进来，我全身都在放电。
lines.en: Water gets in and my whole body discharges.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我推开，电也散了。
lines.en: The blast throws me aside and the charge scatters.

lines.zh: 箭是木的，可箭头导电。
lines.en: The arrow is wood, but its head conducts.

lines.zh: 魔法的光压住我，身上的电安静了。
lines.en: Magic presses me down and the charge goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，电比平时更弱。
lines.en: When hungry, my charge runs weaker than usual.

lines.zh: 天雷打中我，我分不清谁在放电。
lines.en: Sky lightning strikes me and I cannot tell who discharges.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有导体，我的电无处可去。
lines.en: The void has no conductor; my charge has nowhere to go.
